verses.1: When Ephraim spoke, he was carried away in Israel. He was killed by his own husband, and he died.
verses.2: And now, they will be filled with sin and will make themselves offerings from their own money. They will do all kinds of evil things. They say, “These are human offerings.” But they are nothing but worthless things.
verses.3: Therefore, they will be like clouds in the morning, and like dust that moves around as if it were being stirred up from within.
verses.4: And I, the LORD your God, will bring you out of Egypt. Your gods will not be known anymore, and there will be no more rulers over you.
verses.5: I know you in the desert, in the land of Tala’ovot.
verses.6: Like their enemies, they were defeated and humiliated. Their hearts became filled with sorrow, and they forgot about me.
verses.7: And it became like rain for them, as it is said on the road to Ashur.
verses.8: I will break them like straw; I will tear apart their hearts. They will be eaten by dogs in the wilderness.
verses.9: Israel will be saved through your help.
verses.10: Ehie, your king, will save you in all your cities. He will judge you according to what you have said: “Give me a king and servants.”
verses.11: I will give you a king in Aphi, and I will take him away from me.
verses.12: The curse of Ephraim’s sin has been fulfilled. His sins have been punished.
verses.13: The threads of his birth will come to him. He is not wise, for he will never stand in the place of children.
verses.14: From now on, they will be saved from death. O Elohim, your words are true. Death is nothing but a illusion. Shalom, peace will be hidden from our eyes.
verses.15: For he is a son of brothers. Yafriya will come before God’s throne. The spirit of God will descend from the east, and he will destroy everything that is evil. He will plow up all the crops.
